_comment: Lead-terminologist consistency layer applied by merge-glossary.mjs on top of .translation/glossary-parts. rules: site-wide head-word decisions (also enforced by check-glossary.mjs). replace: regex rewrites per language. override: per-entry corrections. add: entries missing from the parts.

ckb: hip pain = ئازاری سمت (region, not only the joint)
clinic name العمران = Al-Imran (matches Latin Alimran)

rehabilitation.note: Site-wide: بەتواناکردنەوە (KRG usage); English on first mention since clinics also say ڕیهابیلیتەیشن.

anterior cervical discectomy and fusion.ckb: لابردنی دیسکی مل لە پێشەوە و لکاندنی بڕبڕەکان

cervical discectomy and fusion.ckb: لابردنی دیسکی مل و لکاندنی بڕبڕەکان

CSF drainage trial.ckb: تاقیکردنەوەی دەرهێنانی شلەی مێشک و درکەپەتک

hip girdle.note: = pelvic girdle, so حەوز (pelvis) is intended, not سمت.

Botox injections.note: brand Botox kept Latin (see entry Botox).

CRPS.note: complex regional pain syndrome. CRP (C-reactive protein) is a separate entry.

Alimran Clinic.note: Clinic name: tr Latin Alimran; ckb ئەلعیمران (Kurdish script of العمران, read al-Imran).

Alimran Medical Center.note: Clinic name: tr Latin Alimran; ckb ئەلعیمران (Kurdish script of العمران, read al-Imran).

medial tibial stress syndrome.ckb: سەندرۆمی فشاری لای ناوەوەی ئێسکی قەڵەم

spinal tap.ckb: دەرهێنانی شلەی مێشک و درکەپەتک لە کەمەرەوە

stereotactic lesioning.ckb: دروستکردنی زەدەی مەبەستدار بە ڕێگای ستیریۆتاکتیک

obstructive sleep apnea.ckb: وەستانی هەناسە لە خەودا بەهۆی داخرانی ڕێڕەوی هەوا

Bell's palsy.note: eponym kept so it differs from facial palsy (ئیفلیجی ڕوخسار); avoids circular definitions.

seizures.note: a seizure = one attack (هێرشی فێ); epilepsy = the disease (فێ).

regional block.note: a nerve block of a region; local anaesthesia (بەنجی ناوچەیی) is a separate concept.

blood clots.note: the clot itself; blood clotting (the process) = مەیینی خوێن.

autoimmune.ckb: خۆبەرگری (بەرگریی لەش هێرش دەکاتە سەر خۆی)

radiating pain.ckb: ئازاری بڵاوبووە (ئازارێک کە بۆ بەشێکی تری لەش دەگوازرێتەوە)

FIBMS.tr: FIBMS (Irak Tıp Uzmanlık Kurulu fellowship eğitimi)

add.note: C-reactive protein lab test; previously mis-merged into CRPS. ckb: lab name read as-is in Iraqi labs.
brand; identical in every entry. ckb reading: بۆتۆکس.
generic: covers surgical and SpineMED non-surgical decompression; previously mis-merged into surgical decompression.
the drugs; sedation (the state) is a separate entry.
Doctor's name; ar.md: حسين عمران موسى. Not in terms.json (scanner missed it), added manually.
when a treatment is medically justified; never ئامادەکاری (preparation). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
reason a treatment must not be given. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
expected outcome/course. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
sudden-onset/short-lived; never توند or توندوتیژ. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
tissue/wound healing; recovery of the patient is چاکبوونەوە. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
patient goes home the same day. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
amount of medicine taken at one time. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
small incision or needle only. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).

add.ckb: بێ دەستێوەردان (بێ بڕین و بێ دەرزی)
add.note: no incision and no needle. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
rest, physiotherapy and medication before any procedure. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
never ئاو هاتنە دەم (mouth-watering). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
physical injury from force (fall, accident); not psychological trauma. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
what the patient cannot do; NOT the therapist restricting activity. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
severity; do not use توند (reserved, reads as acute/violent). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
gets worse over time; not پێشکەوتوو (advanced). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
distinct from fixation (جێگیرکردن). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
a single treatment visit. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
tr: not kalıcı (= permanent). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
the immune system attacks the body itself. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
jaw = شەویلگە; chin is چەناگە. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
duration; chronic (disease) is درێژخایەن. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
cauda equina red flag; same meaning as saddle anaesthesia. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
barriers the patient faces, not restrictions imposed by the therapist. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
weakness left after recovery; tr not kalıcı (permanent). Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
video button. Round 2 clinical vocabulary (manual add).
Post-residency fellowship (CV credential). tr: never "burs" (scholarship). ckb: placeholder transliteration, not yet reviewed by a Sorani speaker.

_allowedVariantClustersComment: Reviewed false positives of the spelling-variant check (different words with a similar skeleton).

trVariantRules._comment: tr only: extra/changed variant_rules applied by merge-glossary.mjs. gloss:"" = explicitly no gloss for that variant (do not inherit the entry gloss). A variant not yet in terms.json is appended to the entry variants.

_glossRule: check-glossary.mjs (tr): gloss must differ from text and from the English term; merge-glossary.mjs drops such glosses.
